title: Germany rejects RFK Jr claims about Covid vaccine exemption prosecutions
summary: Health minister Nina Warken says Robert F Kennedy Jr’s assertions that German doctors are facing legal action are unfounded The German government has sharply rejected claims by the US health secretary, Robert F Kennedy Jr, that doctors in Germany have faced legal action for issuing vaccine and mask exemptions during the Covid-19 pandemic. “The statements made by the US secretary of health are completely unfounded, factually incorrect, and must be rejected,” Germany’s health minister, Nina Warken, said in a strongly worded statement released late on Saturday.
